title: Tuviah the Physician
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:7, where Rabbi Yose relates an incident of Tuviah the physician, who saw the new moon in Jerusalem — he, his son and his freed slave. The priests accepted him … and when they came to the court, they accepted him and his slave, etc. Hyman infers from this that he lived in Temple times, while the court was still in Jerusalem.
